data.name: Julebryg Spiced Lager
data.longDescription: The story goes that the first Julebryg (Christmas Brew), was made by Carlsminde Brewery in 1958. Vikings were known to brew a high-powered beer-like drink to get them through the dark winter months. The popularity of this seasonal beer prompted other breweries to follow. Over the years, this dark pilsner has become a clear sign that Christmas has arrived in Denmark. The annual launch, known as 'J-day', takes place the first Friday in November and is a day of celebration across Denmark. Brewery truck drivers deliver to bars and cafés while singing the traditional Christmas Brew song and handing out free beer to the guests to mark the start of the festive season. Dark-golden colour with a fresh aroma of caramel, cereal, liquorice and blackcurrant, Julebryg is a bottom-fermented wiener beer, the perfect companion to add some European spice to your Christmas celebrations!
data.brewNotes:
This brew requires additional ingredients that you will need to source; half a Star Anise, half a Vanilla Bean, 1 Cinnamon stick. After fermentation, boil 1 cup of water, add spices and infuse for 10 minutes, tip into BeerDroid along with single Hop pouch addition and infuse for 24 hours prior to kegging. 

Beware when brewing this bold beer, due to it’s vigorous fermentation it may overflow from the vent port for the first 48 hours.

Aromas of coffee and chocolate burst out of the glass, and from the first sip, its luxurious texture will fill your mouth, before rounding out with a bold and majestic bitterness. This brew will get you through the toughest of winters.

data.name: Midlands Pale Ale
data.shortDescription: Fine balance of malt and fruit
data.longDescription: Sweet, full bodied and fruity, Midlands Pale Ale pours with a coarse white head on deep amber. A finely balanced beer with a distinctive rich malty taste and toffee, fruity aromas. Smooth and slightly drying finish.

data.name: Mountain Range IPA
data.shortDescription: Big and bold in the American way
data.longDescription: A big American style beer with an assertive full flavour and pine and tropical fruit characters. Enjoy mouthfilling goodness of malt and citrus with a very firm bitter finish, pine and herbal character. PLEASE NOTE: This BrewPrint contains Dry Hops! The Dry Hop Filter is required to filter out hop debris.
data.brewNotes:
This BrewPrint has been improved with the inclusion of Dry Hops for enhanced flavour and aroma.
We strongly recommend the use of the Dry Hop Filter to avoid blocking of kegging and bottling equipment from hop debris.

You may brew without Dry Hops using BrewArt ingredients and substituting the Dry Hops for 2x Hops 2.
Note you will need to use the appropriate brewing program, as listed above.

data.name: Mönch Lager
data.longDescription: A full-flavoured European lager with a distinctive malt taste in a style that dates back centuries. Refreshing and vibrant on the palate, enjoy its soft herb and flower aromas, subtle malt and moderate bitterness.

data.name: Narci-Citrus IPA
data.longDescription: Bold and beautiful with an attractive bitterness, this proud IPA pours light amber into the glass, and settles beneath a thick, creamy head. The lush and juicy aromas of passionfruit, citrus and stone fruit leap out, while a muscular malty backbone and sweet caramel flavours calm the hops-driven undertones. PLEASE NOTE: This BrewPrint contains Dry Hops! The Dry Hop Filter is required to filter out hop debris.

data.name: Neder Lager
data.shortDescription: Classic lager in the Dutch style
data.longDescription: A crisp, clean, refreshing lager the colour of pale straw. Savour the scent of herb, flower and subtle malt before quaffing. Enjoy rounded soft biscuit flavours with a cleansing bitter finish on the palate.

data.name: Old Saxon Schwarzbier
data.longDescription: This beer is the great pretender, with the appearance of a stout, and the crispness of a lager this is the perfect gateway beer to the dark side. When poured its appearance is a dark brown to black with a thick beige head. The aroma has small hints of roast malt, and noble hops, with a nice bready malt backbone. There is a slight caramel chocolate taste to start with a crisp lager like finish to keep you wanting to come back for more.

data.name: Polski Baltic Porter
data.shortDescription: A dark beer for the ages
data.longDescription: A deep brown Polish style porter ale with a fine beige foam, sweet caramel, chocolate and hint of licorice characters, rich roasted malts, dried fruits with a smooth warming finish. Enjoy the focused flavours.
data.brewNotes: The higher alcohol content of this brew requires a modification to the regular BrewPrint procedure. Only fill your BeerDroid with 9L of water, which with the addition of the ingredients will still make 10L of beer. Beware when brewing this bold beer, due to its vigorous fermentation it may overflow from the vent port for the first 48 hours.

data.name: Rapid River Ale
data.shortDescription: An ale that flows sweet and pure
data.longDescription: Big, bold and perfectly balanced, enjoy the ride with this fresh outdoorsy ale. Flowing pale amber to the glass, aromas of pine, grapefruit and spring flowers stream out. Your tastebuds are first met with a flash of bitterness which is swiftly calmed by the malty sweetness beyond. PLEASE NOTE: This BrewPrint contains Dry Hops! The Dry Hop Filter is required to filter out hop debris.

data.name: Revolution Dark Lager
data.longDescription: With deep amber hues topped by a creamy milk coffee head, enjoy the aromas of sweet biscuit, citrus and flowers in this Vienna-style lager, before embracing a mouth filling balance of toasty sweet malt with a cleansing bitter finish.

data.name: Ruby Porter
data.longDescription: With a wicked ruby red glow, white creamy foam, and cleansing moderately bitter finish, this British styled beer balanced with hints of toffee and faint chocolate is sure to intrigue even the most experienced beer taster.
data.brewNotes: Beware when brewing this bold beer, due to its vigorous fermentation it may overflow from the vent port for the first 48 hours.

data.name: Shadow Hill Porter
data.shortDescription: The porter to get you up the mountain
data.longDescription: Fresh as an alpine breeze but with a warmth of spirit that typifies mountain life, this rich, dark creamy porter reaches new heights in flavour and intensity. There’s cocoa, coffee, roasted malt and pine needles in the air, and on the lips: sweet caramel covered in layers of chocolate, followed by a gentle hops bitterness to keep this full-bodied ale crisp and refreshing.
data.brewNotes: A hop blend is required for this brew, so add the hop sachets to the BeerDroid at the End Of Fermentation notification and let infuse as if you were bottling.

data.name: Spoke Amber Ale
data.shortDescription: A new world ale to spin your wheels
data.longDescription: Spoke is a flavoursome amber ale with a sweet, malt biscuit character and a touch of toffee that rides along smoothly with crisp hop bitterness. It’s a cruise to the finish line as subtle esters perfectly balance this new world take on an old classic. PLEASE NOTE: This BrewPrint contains Dry Hops! The Dry Hop Filter is required to filter out hop debris.

data.name: Stars & Stripes Lager
data.longDescription: One of America’s favourite beer styles, you’ll find Stars & Stripes Lager medium-bodied, flavourful and crisp with a bright white head, subtle floral spice aroma, smooth grain flavours and a spritzy drying finish.
data.brewNotes: The delicate hop aroma desired for beer is achieved using a single dose of H1 for your full 10L brew. Unlike other BrewPrints, you will need to infuse a single H1 sachet directly into the BeerDroid, following notification that fermentation is complete (as you would if bottling).

data.name: Tall Tale Ale
data.longDescription: Without a word of a lie, this adventurous, straw-coloured ale has a fine story to tell. The beginning displays subtle hints of citrus and stone fruit supported by bready undertones. A crisp bitterness rounds out this tale with well-balanced conclusion. It is truly an epic ale, you’ll definitely want to share. PLEASE NOTE: This BrewPrint contains Dry Hops! The Dry Hop Filter is required to filter out hop debris.

This revolutionary recipe uses sweet amber malts and noble hops to produce both floral and earthy notes that are the toast of everyman. Break free from the chains of flavourless beer oppression and declare your allegiance to the amber flag of Tea Party Lager. PLEASE NOTE: This BrewPrint contains Dry Hops! Bursting with bright passionfruit aromas and undertones of raisins. With a big mouthfeel the flavours of Toffee, Citrus, and Resin coat your tongue, finishing with a crisp bitterness. data.name: The Original Pilsner
data.longDescription: An intensely hoppy, full-bodied flavour reminiscent of the original Pilsners, with a characteristically fine bitterness against a background of caramel sweetness with a spicy hop finish. Pours with a creamy white head and scents of fresh bread and honeysuckle.

data.name: The Point IPA
data.longDescription: Perfect for a sunny afternoon on the coast this bright amber IPA will not disappoint. The light malt bill steps aside and makes way for the aromatic hops to shine, with fragrances of Apricot, Peach and Mango this big beer is bold yet finishes with a crisp bitterness. PLEASE NOTE: This BrewPrint contains Dry Hops! The Dry Hop Filter is required to filter out hop debris.

data.name: Thomas Coopers Artisan Reserve
data.shortDescription: A craft brew with a touch of class
data.longDescription: With an appetising soft and creamy head, bright golden yellow colour and scent of freshly cut lime and orange peel, the Artisan Reserve style brew has a balanced malt character and crisp finish in the Pilsner tradition.

data.name: Thomas Coopers Celebration Ale
data.longDescription: Crafted to celebrate 150 years of beer making by the Cooper family, Thomas Coopers Celebration Ale inspired this hops-driven traditional ale with a dark-red hue and tropical fruit esters. Smooth malt and a warming finish on the palate. PLEASE NOTE: This BrewPrint contains Dry Hops! The Dry Hop Filter is required to filter out hop debris.

data.name: Top End Crisp Lager
data.longDescription: Specially created in time for summer, this beer was developed with the Aussie tropics in mind and is sure to quench your thirst when the mercury rises. Easy drinking, with low bitterness and low alcohol, its gentle, herb and floral aromas are backed up by a welcome dryness and a refreshing finish.
data.brewNotes: The delicate hop aroma desired for this mid-strength summer favourite is achieved using a single dose of H5 for your full 10L brew. Unlike other BrewPrints, you will need to infuse a single H5 sachet directly into the BeerDroid, following notification that fermentation is complete (as you would if bottling).

data.name: Traditional Irish Stout
data.longDescription: Reminiscent of Ireland’s world-famous velvety stout, Traditional Irish Stout boasts a creamy tan head, brown-black and garnet hues. Enjoy the scent of roasted coffee and barley and the rich familiar taste of roast coffee and dark chocolate, slightly acidic on the finish.

data.name: US Chiller Lager
data.longDescription: The finest malted barley, selected cereal grains and choicest hops combine to create this popular quaffing beer. Floral and slightly estery on the nose, sip through coarse white foam to enjoy the smooth dry finish with malt-balanced soft bitterness.

data.name: West Coast Pale Ale
data.shortDescription: Fine balance of sweet and bitter
data.longDescription: An exceptional example of a classic pale ale, West Coast Pale Ale has a complex character that incorporates citrus, pine and grapefruit. Malty with marmalade and sweet flavours then firm bitterness. Beer aficionados will appreciate the complexity. PLEASE NOTE: This BrewPrint contains Dry Hops! The Dry Hop Filter is required to filter out hop debris.

data.name: Wicked Night Pumpkin Ale
data.longDescription: There’s nothing ghoulish about our traditional Halloween recipe. A spirited brew that would make Dr Frankenstein proud, simply add in a few dark spices to concoct an ale that looks like a beer, but tastes like a mouth-watering slice of pumpkin pie, with aromas of nutmeg and sweet, toffee malt flavour.
data.brewNotes:
This brew requires additional ingredients that you will need to source; 0.75gm Star Anise, 1.25gm Cinnamon, 1.25gm Nutmeg, 1.25gm All Spice, 1.25gm Ginger, 1.25gm Clove.   After fermentation, boil 1 cup of water, add spices and infuse for 15 minutes, strain into BeerDroid along with single Hop pouch addition.

Beware when brewing this bold beer, due to it’s vigorous fermentation it may overflow from the vent port for the first 48 hours.

The delicate hop aroma desired for this BrewPrint is achieved using a single Hop dose for your full 10L brew. 
Unlike other BrewPrints, you will need to infuse a single Hop sachet directly into the BeerDroid, following notification that fermentation is complete (as you would if bottling).

data.name: Big Valley Haze
data.shortDescription: A haze you’ll want to get lost in.
data.longDescription: This lush and pillowy IPA bursts with vibrant hop character, bringing bold, juicy tropical fruit flavours—mango, passionfruit, and citrus zest—front and centre. Soft stone fruit aromas and a touch of fresh pine add complexity, while a smooth, resinous finish delivers a balanced sweetness that lingers. It's a haze that invites you to get lost in every sip.
